title: What is Wingman
content:
## Overview

**Wingman** is Emergent's standalone personal AI assistant with persistent memory. It is a separate product from Emergent's app-building platform and is designed to help you with everyday tasks, questions, and conversations while remembering context across sessions.

Wingman is available on multiple platforms:

- **Web** – [getwingman.com](https://getwingman.com)
- **Android** – Google Play Store
- **iOS** – Apple App Store

<Note>
Wingman is **not** the AI that builds your apps inside Emergent. It is a personal assistant you can use for general productivity, brainstorming, research, and more.
</Note>

## Key features

- **Persistent memory** – Wingman remembers your preferences, past conversations, and context over time, making interactions more personalized and efficient.
- **Multi-platform sync** – Start a conversation on your phone and continue it on the web, with memory carried across devices.
- **General-purpose assistant** – Ask questions, get summaries, draft content, or receive help with a wide range of everyday tasks.

## How it differs from Emergent's app builder

| Feature | Emergent App Builder | Wingman |
|---------|---------------------|---------|
| **Purpose** | Build, test and deploy apps via chat | Personal AI assistant for general tasks |
| **Memory** | Project-specific workspace context | Cross-conversation persistent memory |
| **Access** | Emergent platform workspace | Standalone web app & mobile apps |
| **Output** | Deployed web/mobile applications | Conversational assistance & answers |

## Getting started

<Steps>
<Step title="Choose your platform">
Visit [getwingman.com](https://getwingman.com), or download the app from the Play Store (Android) or App Store (iOS).
</Step>

<Step title="Sign in">
Create an account or sign in with your existing credentials. Your memory and conversation history will sync across all platforms where you're logged in.
</Step>

<Step title="Start chatting">
Ask Wingman anything—questions, tasks, ideas—and it will remember your preferences and context for future conversations.
</Step>
</Steps>

<Tip>
Wingman's persistent memory means you don't need to re-explain your preferences or background every time you chat. The more you use it, the more tailored your experience becomes.
</Tip>

## Privacy & memory

Wingman's memory is designed to enhance your experience by retaining context. You remain in control:

- Memory is tied to your account and syncs across your devices.
- You can manage or clear stored memory at any time through the app settings.
- Conversations and memory are not shared with other users or used to train Emergent's app-building models.

<Info>
For questions about data handling and privacy, refer to Wingman's privacy policy available in-app and on the website.
</Info>
description: Emergent's standalone personal AI assistant with persistent memory - separate from the app builder; available on web (getwingman.com), the Play Store and the App Store.
